investigation: The matched Apple M3 Max capture-off comparison exceeded 8.33 ms in all three Sky arms. The same 921,600 half-extent rays and 122,173,520 bytes were admitted. Trace and compose dominate. Overcast visited 7.4% as many samples as fair and spent 47.7% as long in the trace. The counter counts empty travel and leaves out the nested solar-light steps. A closed deck encounters dense cloud and reaches the transmission limit quickly. Each visit to its dense region performs optical work. The broken weather map rose from 0.068 to 0.097 ms as it evaluated the extra pitch-scale field at intermediate deck coverage. Clear, fair and a fully closed deck bypass that field, and dispatch dimensions remain matched. Overcast hemisphere light rose from 0.196 to 0.261 ms. That pass runs the same sky-radiance quadrature and reads no cloud field. Equal work and the shared-load record leave the timing difference unassigned. Earlier paired runs saw different small-pass tripwires. The large trace and compose times call for later tuning.
